calculation.description: Ranks assets that underperformed their contemporaneous 3-day cross-asset median, normalized by trailing 20-day close-to-close volatility; higher values indicate stronger expected next-day rebound. Cross-sectional median is formed using only same-date available observations.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.06089; 297 observations), 2023-2024 (0.03025; 200), and 2025-2026 (0.05573; 272). Horizon decay is visible by 10 days.
validation.gate: Passed absolute daily IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR >= 0.0840
